answer:
The last surviving Canadian Father of Confederation was **Sir Charles Tupper**. He died on October 30, 1915, at the age of 94, outliving other prominent figures like John A. Macdonald (who died in 1891) and George-Étienne Cartier (who died in 1873).

His father was **Reverend Charles Tupper**, a Presbyterian minister from Nova Scotia, and his mother was Miriam Lockhart.
